discovery_library_rule: retain a structure only if it has exact programs on at least two distinct discovery task identities; structure hash excludes colour arguments
library_selection: all qualifying structures ordered by structure hash; no manual selection
success_requirement: at least one frozen structure solves a distinct validation task identity with exact dual-runtime outputs and frozen-v17 failure
validation_rule: freeze the complete discovery library before generating validation examples; infer only colour arguments on validation tasks; no structure edits
